throughput.name: 8 JIRLs x 1000 loop iterations
throughput.asm: la.local $r4, .Lloop; addi.d $r5, $r4, 4; addi.d $r6, $r4, 8; addi.d $r7, $r4, 12; addi.d $r8, $r4, 16; addi.d $r9, $r4, 20; addi.d $r10, $r4, 24; addi.d $r11, $r4, 28; .Lloop:; jirl $r0, $r4, 4; jirl $r0, $r5, 4; jirl $r0, $r6, 4; jirl $r0, $r7, 4; jirl $r0, $r8, 4; jirl $r0, $r9, 4; jirl $r0, $r10, 4; jirl $r0, $r11, 4; addi.d $r12, $r12, -1; bnez $r12, .Lloop
throughput.command: ./bench --unroll 1 --iters 1000 --warmup 10 --reps 10 --core 0 --init 'li.d $r12, 1000' --asm 'la.local $r4, .Lloop; addi.d $r5, $r4, 4; addi.d $r6, $r4, 8; addi.d $r7, $r4, 12; addi.d $r8, $r4, 16; addi.d $r9, $r4, 20; addi.d $r10, $r4, 24; addi.d $r11, $r4, 28; .Lloop:; jirl $r0, $r4, 4; jirl $r0, $r5, 4; jirl $r0, $r6, 4; jirl $r0, $r7, 4; jirl $r0, $r8, 4; jirl $r0, $r9, 4; jirl $r0, $r10, 4; jirl $r0, $r11, 4; addi.d $r12, $r12, -1; bnez $r12, .Lloop'
throughput.notes: Eight static JIRLs are reused in a 1000-iteration loop, avoiding BTB capacity pressure. The loop without JIRLs takes 1013.01 cycles; the JIRL loop takes 25016.97 cycles, so marginal throughput is (25016.97-1013.01)/8000 = 3.0005 CPI. lanes is the total number of JIRLs executed per benchmark sequence (8 x 1000).

notes: No destination data dependency; latency is not defined. Throughput is measured with looped JIRLs to avoid BTB pressure.
